prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in League City, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1032; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can use the claim file.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the accident happened?
A: I was in League City, Texas, turning left off the main road into a shopping center.
Q: What were you doing right before the turn?
A: I was slowing down, signaling, and waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic. There was a truck coming toward me and I thought I had time.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you started the turn?
A: I saw headlights, but I thought they were farther away than they were. I started moving and then the car hit my front passenger side.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: How fast were you going when you began the turn?
A: Maybe ten or fifteen miles an hour. I wasn't going fast.
Q: Did you hit your head?
A: Yes. The airbag went off and my head hit the side window. I felt dizzy and had a headache right away.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Yes. I still get headaches, I'm sensitive to light, and I've had trouble concentrating at work.
Q: Have you seen a doctor since the accident?
A: I was taken to the emergency room, and I'm scheduled to see a neurologist next week.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm sorry for the accident, and I hope the other driver is okay.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
